description: The Aruba MOVE Architecture forms the core network infrastructure for supporting mobile and wireless computing devices. The system enables enterprise-scale 802.11 wireless LANs (Wi-Fi), secure remote VPNs, and mobility-optimized wired networks. The Broadcom XLP Series includes Broadcom XLP 204, XLP 208, XLP 316, XLP 408, XLP 416 and XLP 432 processors; the Freescale QorIQ P10XX Series includes P1010 and P1020 processors.
